verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents a self-serve API key process (dashboard → Integrations → copy key) and bearer-token auth, plus a full GraphQL API with transcripts/transcript queries for pulling meeting data, and separate product features confirm summaries and action items are generated per meeting. Missing for 10: explicit API-level documentation showing action items/summary fields returned by the transcript query (only inferred from marketing pages) and independent developer corroboration of the self-serve flow working smoothly.
